findings.claim: VersionHistoryPanel.tsx is edited although the touch points name neither it nor any layout change to the file page's editor, and its open grid switches from the viewport breakpoint `lg:` to the container query `@xl:` unconditionally, not only when `frameless`.
findings.impact: On the file page (where KnowledgeEditSection mounts the same Editor and panel), the version list and preview now lay out side by side whenever the panel is at least 36rem wide, not whenever the viewport is at least 1024px. A tablet-width file page (640–1023px viewport) draws two columns where it drew one, and a narrow desktop column draws one where it drew two. This changes the file page beyond the spec's statement that Editor 'gains the optional saveHandle prop and nothing else'.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/VersionHistoryPanel.tsx:248 adds `@container`; :267 `grid gap-4 @xl:grid-cols-[minmax(14rem,20rem)_minmax(0,1fr)]` (was `lg:grid-cols-…`), with no `frameless` condition. The panel is rendered from Editor.tsx:1557 for every host, including the file page.
findings.repro: not_reproduced (read only). Mutation in thought: on the file page at a 900px viewport with the panel ~600px wide, the class `@xl:grid-cols-…` applies, where before `lg:` did not.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant covers the version panel's layout (I12 covers requests, the save indicator and the view-mode toggle). The reach falls outside the touch points and the 'nothing else' scope statement.

findings.proposed_fix: Either declare VersionHistoryPanel.tsx (and its file-page layout change) in the touch points, or make the `@container`/`@xl:` switch apply only under `frameless`, keeping `lg:` for the file page.

findings.claim: Editor.tsx, EditorToolbar.tsx and KnowledgeEditSection.tsx gain a second optional prop `frameless` (toolbar rule, toolbar inset, `.cm-content` left padding, version-panel rule), but the touch points say Editor gains `saveHandle` 'and nothing else' and do not list EditorToolbar.tsx at all.
findings.impact: A reader working from the touch points would not expect the shared toolbar and editor host classes to change. The default (`frameless` absent) keeps the file page's classes, so a user hits nothing unless F1's unconditional part applies.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/Editor.tsx:131,207,1453,1493,1562; EditorToolbar.tsx:236,246,283 (class now built from `frameless`); KnowledgeEditSection.tsx:46,54,104; used only from library/pane/NotePaneContainer.tsx:255.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is broken; the file page passes no `frameless`, and Editor.saveHandle.acceptance.test.tsx pins the default classes. It is an undeclared reach.

findings.proposed_fix: Add EditorToolbar.tsx, VersionHistoryPanel.tsx and the `frameless` prop to the touch points.
